page.layout: One printed page, one text column in roman type with Greek in one place. Running head at top centre. Page number at top right. Margin notes in the right margin, as small marks only. Gathering signature at bottom left and catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: cidem religionum contemptorem ma-ximum, cujus in Alcibiade meminit Plutarchus, & in historiâ suâ Thucydides, licet nomen ejus silentio premat. Totus namque in eo est Lysias, ut con-temptum religionum, quæ summa est impietas, crimen esse atrocissimum & capitis pœnâ dignum demonstret, & Andocidem ad ix-viratum adspirantem non solum repellendum, sed etiam è medio tollendum ostendat. Affirmat verò ex sententiâ Periclis quondam populum hac de re monentis, contra virum hujusmodi non solum legibus scriptis, sed etiam non scriptis secundum interpretationem Eumolpidarum esse[illegible, ~2 letters] utendum. Atque hujus quidem ejusdem criminis obtentu per pessimam calumniam ab æmulis oppressus innocentissimus Socrates philosophus, aliter de divino numine ac vulgus superstitiosum sentiens, temerè in Helixâ damnatus in carcere haustâ cicutâ mortem oppetiit. Erat enim populus Atticus mirificè superstitionibus deditus, ideoque[illegible, ~2 letters] multis post sæculis δεισιδαιμονέστερ[?] ab apostolo Paulo est nuncupatus. Qui in custodiam dabantur apud xi-viros, alii aliis arctius habebantur. Quidam enim fine[?] aliis vinculis agebant solis pa-rietibus clausi, quidam cippo seu com-
main_text.notes: Left margin: a column of small marks, probably show-through or the edge of the neighbouring page; not transcribed. Bottom right: faint marks and a line of text under the signature are show-through or digitiser material and are not transcribed. Greek word after "sæculis" is read with doubt at its last letters. Right-margin marks beside "esse" and "ideoque" are too small to read reliably. The "ideoqu" line is partly covered by a mark, so "ideoque" is uncertain. "fine" is uncertain.
